## About me

I'm a Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of experience working across the stack, from frontend to backend, focused on reliable engineering and thoughtful solutions.

I use AI to accelerate implementation while taking ownership of technical decisions and the quality of what I build.

💻 How I got here
Back in 2020, during COVID, I started learning to code through YouTube tutorials.

In 2021, before finishing school, I landed my first job as a Frontend Engineer. Over time, I moved into backend development and grew into a Full Stack Engineer.

Now I'm continuing to build, learn, and explore.
